source.title: Igor - Mad Dagger
source.name: Igor
source.description: An agile Warrior who can jump between tombstones to deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Funereal Ring

description.raw: Igor summons a tombstone where he stands when a battle starts. Everytime an enemy hero losses 40% of thier HP, Igor summons another tombstone on an empty tile closest to this enemy which will disappear after receiving 3 normal attacks. Igor will always stand on the tombstone and remain steadfast. Igor deals 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies upon casting this skill.
active: Igor summons a tombstone where he stands when a battle starts.
Everytime an enemy hero losses 40% of thier HP, Igor summons another tombstone on an empty tile closest to this enemy which will disappear after receiving 3 normal attacks.
Igor will always stand on the tombstone and remain steadfast.
Igor deals 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies upon casting this skill.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases damage to 210% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 270% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Igor deals damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Ghastly Explosion

description.raw: Igor activates all tombstones every 8s or whenever he casts Funereal Ring. He jumps onto an activated tombstone, dealing 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage adjacent enemies and deactivating the tombstone. While casting this skill, Igor gains damage immunity and cannot be targeted. If he jumps onto a tombstone activated by Funereal Ring, he deals an extra 50% damage.
active: Igor activates all tombstones every 8s or whenever he casts Funereal Ring.
He jumps onto an activated tombstone, dealing 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage adjacent enemies and deactivating the tombstone.
While casting this skill, Igor gains damage immunity and cannot be targeted.
If he jumps onto a tombstone activated by Funereal Ring, he deals an extra 50% damage.

text: Increases damage to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases damage to 160% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases damage to 170% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Igor jumps onto an activated tombstone, dealing damage to nearby enemies and then deactivating the tombstone.

skills.name: Specter Guard

description.raw: Igor jumps onto anoter tombstone to dodge a fatal blow and gains damage immunity while using this skill. Each time Igor uses Ghastly Explosion or Specter Guard to jump between tombstones, he recovers 3% (HP-based) + 0.8% (SP-based) HP. After casting Specter Guard 6 times, each subsequent cast increases the HP loss ration required to summon a tombstone with Funereal Ring by 12%. herself
active: Igor jumps onto anoter tombstone to dodge a fatal blow and gains damage immunity while using this skill.

skills.name: Horror Strike

description.raw: Igor extends the range of Ghastly Explosion by 1 tile and reduces the target's healing received by 50% for 4s when his HP ratio is above 70%.
active: Igor extends the range of Ghastly Explosion by 1 tile and reduces the target's healing received by 50% for 4s when his HP ratio is above 70%.

Enhances Ghastly Explosion once with each cast of Specter Guard, regardless of Igor's HP ratio.
Reduces the target's healing recieved for 6s.
